holdout: Train on matches before 2025; evaluate on 2025 recorded matches
method: Ladder position is derived chronologically from the same match results using 4 points for a win, 2 for a draw, 0 for a loss, with score-for/score-against percentage as tie-breaker. Model features are leakage-safe rolling features shifted before each match.
interpretation: On the 2025 held-out season, the model achieved 66.5% accuracy versus 65.6% for the ladder-position naive benchmark and 55.8% for home-team-always. The model therefore provides only a small lift over the ladder baseline in this holdout and should be presented as probabilistic evidence, not certainty.
